statement: For s>0 ovals: 8(2^(s−1)−1) real planes in the separating case; 2^(s+2) otherwise. This is the real-plane count by topology on the source locus, not the separate spectrum of totally-real contact planes. The full generic-plane spectrum is not asserted here.

notes:
Substitute g=4 in the two real-odd-theta formulas. This is a count of real tritangent planes; contact points may consist of one real point and a nonreal conjugate pair. The previous attribution to Kulkarni et al. Theorem 1.1 and its five-oval/three-real-contact scope mixed this with a different result: that theorem constructs 84,…,120 totally real contact planes. The corrected scope and source refer to the plane-count question. This pass inspected Harris–Len Proposition 3.1 directly; it did not fully check the paper.

Originality audit: the theta-characteristic formulas already appear with proof in Gross–Harris (1981), Proposition 5.1. Specialization to g=4 and the classical tritangent correspondence give this record. Harris–Len remains the inspected exposition in source, not the original theta-count attribution. Absolute priority before 1981 remains open.
scope: Smooth real canonical genus-four sextics on a smooth quadric, with s>0 real ovals and regular tritangent fibre; real planes are counted regardless of whether all contact points are real.
